exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: DELOAD to 70kg (from 75). On 07-31 you went 8 / 6 / 5 at RPE 10 - that is not a hold, that is a set falling apart under you, and it is the exact pattern the Day A deload just fixed. 70kg x 8 x 3 clean is worth more than 75 x 8/6/5. LOWER BACK: this is the highest-risk lift on the board for you and form breaks first at RPE 10. Hips back, bar close, stop the rep when the lower back rounds - not when the hamstrings give out. Target RPE 8.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip
exercises.notes: HOLD 4x5 bodyweight. Four clean sets of 5 on 07-31 but at RPE 10, so no added load. Quiet win worth naming: you are doing the same reps at a lighter bodyweight than in June, which is a real strength gain the log does not show as a number. When these land at RPE 8, we add reps before we add weight.

exercises.name: Machine Seated Row
exercises.notes: UP to 22.5kg (from 20). This is the ONLY lift going up today and it earned it outright: 3x12 at RPE 8 on 07-31, the single cleanest set of data in that session. Textbook accessory progression - top of the rep range at RPE 8 means add load.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.notes: HOLD 30kg, target 10. You ran 12 / 10 / 10 at RPE 9 - the first set was ahead of the other two, which means 12 was the outlier not the standard. Three honest 10s at RPE 8, then we move. Preacher drop set is still coming at the end, so leave something in the tank.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: DOWN to 40kg (you ran 45 / 45 / 40 at RPE 9). This is prehab, not a lift - it exists for shoulder health and posture, and RPE 9 on a face pull is missing the point of the exercise. 40kg is what your third set self-selected anyway. High elbows, pull to the forehead, squeeze the rear delts, no leaning back to move the stack.

exercises.name: Box Situp
exercises.notes: 3x12 bodyweight. Nothing was logged for this on 07-31 - you swapped in cable crunch 3x15x75 at RPE 9. That sub is fine and I will keep planning the swap if you prefer it, but tell me either way so this slot stops producing empty rows. LOWER BACK: controlled extension over the box, no ballistic hyperextension - this is the movement that got Ab Wheel removed from the program.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: ONE triple-drop, no rest between drops: 35kg to failure -> 30kg -> 25kg. Held at 35 from 07-31 where you got 9 / 5 / 3. That steep a decline is correct for a drop set - it means the first mini-set was genuinely to failure. RPE 10 here is by design, it is the one place today where it belongs.

session_notes: DELOAD IS WORKING - DO NOT UNDO IT. Day A on 08-09 was your cleanest session since June: every set hit target reps, the mid-set rep collapse on shoulder press / leg press / lateral raise disappeared completely, and RPE came off 10 across the board. That validates the approach, so Day B gets the same treatment. WHAT CHANGED: RDL 75 -> 70 (it was collapsing 8/6/5, same pattern the Day A deload fixed), Face Pull 45 -> 40 (prehab should not run at RPE 9), Seated Row 20 -> 22.5 (the only lift going UP - it hit 3x12 at RPE 8, textbook earned progression), EZ Curl target 12 -> 10. Everything else holds. TARGET RPE 8 on compounds, 7-8 on accessories, 10 only on the preacher drop set. OPEN DATA ISSUES, please fix in the log: (1) your Day A wrist curl came through as 25/24/24kg, identical to the reverse curl line above it - that is a copy error, you ran 3x10x60kg on 07-20, so correct it next Day A or the number stays wrong forever; (2) Box Situp has now logged empty twice while you actually did cable crunches - pick one and tell me. BENCH NOTE for next Day A: holding 70, not returning to 72.5. It was the only lift that stayed at RPE 10 through the deload. WEIGH-IN + 27-DAY REVIEW still queued for tomorrow - Day A already argues the hold-calories call on 07-27 was right, since the fatigue was recoverable without cutting food further.
